messages.author: b4996b84aa84692e
messages.subject: JGR "Pop-up window" R process slow
parts:
hi,
this may sound redundant, but i have installed Deducer and JGR following the tips provided in r-interface.blogspot.com.au. when i start JGR and it seems to be working fine, a pop-up window says "This R process is taking some time. Would you like to canel it?" (attached). and there is nothing one can do to get rid off it.

i am running ubuntu 13.04
R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25) -- "Frisbee Sailing"
the java sdk files are fine, no errors with r CMD javarconf

if anyone has any idea, or has come across this issue before?
many thanks,
alan

messages.author: b4996b84aa84692e
messages.subject: Re: JGR "Pop-up window" R process slow
parts:
hi,
problem solved. came across a comment in http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=getting-started:installation:debian that noted to run it once as:

"run once more R as root user to write all script files
  • sudo R
  • > library(JGR)
  • > JGR()
  • quit R"
 that seemed to have worked.
cheers,
alan

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: JGR "Pop-up window" R process slow
parts:
What version of R/JGR are you running ( use sessionInfo() )? Does JGR load fine when Deducer is not set to load at start-up? Try deleting the preference files in your home directory (they are hidden and start with .JGR* and .Deducer*).


ian
